summary: [spec fidelity] Invariant 1 names plain `cargo test --workspace` among the default runs that must not hold the checker crate's tests. It still does: `cargo test --workspace --no-run` builds all 8 atip-check test binaries (4101 tests = 3732 + 369); only `--exclude atip-check` (just test, CI offline) and the nextest default-filter leave them out, and the change says so openly in README and CHANGELOG. This cannot be met inside cargo without moving atip-check out of the workspace or switching its targets to test=false with explicit --test flags, so it is the human's call: amend the invariant to the three runs that are now clean (and re-approve the brief), or order a structural change. Also, CHANGELOG, test.yml and the justfile say `--workspace` ignores `default-members`, but the root Cargo.toml has no default-members: nothing is ignored, and a bare `cargo test` at the root runs atip-check too. Blast radius: scripts/check-witness.sh runs `cargo test --workspace --no-fail-fast` and still includes the checker crate; the offline job name still says `cargo test --workspace`.
